description: This source file defines the 'FtpServices' class which provides FTP file upload and download functionalities using Apache Commons Net FTPClient. It includes methods for transmitting files to or retrieving files from an FTP server, handling connection setup, authentication, transfer mode, passive mode, and error reporting.

classes.name: FtpServices
classes.description: A utility class providing FTP file transfer services such as upload ('putFile') and download ('getFile').

methods.name: putFile
methods.description: Uploads a local file to an FTP server, handling connection setup, login, transfer mode, passive mode, and optional site commands. Returns success or error details.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Downloads a remote file from an FTP server to a local file, managing connection, login, transfer mode, passive mode, and error handling. Returns success or error details.
